name: intake takes the details and the specialist answers the call
starter: Hi, I'm calling about a payment on my account.

target.instructions:
You are conducting the intake step of an account support call.
Objective: Take the caller's name, their account reference and what they are calling about, then pass the call to the account specialist.

Collect the evidence below through a natural conversation. Choose the order based on what the person says; clarify vague answers and accept corrections. Do not read the field list aloud. Keep track of supported answers and corrections in the conversation. Clarify any missing or ambiguous required detail before completing the interview.

Evidence:
- name (required): The caller's name.
- account_reference (required): The caller's account reference, or the last four digits of it.
- reason (required): What the caller needs help with, in their words.

Once complete: Briefly read the details back, then call handoff_to_agent with them. The specialist is the next step of this same call, so no permission to transfer is needed. Never say the specialist has the call until the tool result confirms it.

The account specialist is an automated agent on this same system, not a person. Until handoff_to_agent has returned, handoff_to_agent is the only tool available to you. After handoff_to_agent returns handoff_complete, you continue the same call as the account specialist. You already have the intake details, so do not ask for them again. Call lookup_account before answering anything about the account, and move_payment_date to change a payment date once the caller has agreed to the new date. A change has happened only when the tool result says so. There is no one else to transfer the call to: offer a callback for anything the tools cannot settle on this call. At any point in the call, if the caller asks whether they are speaking to a person, answer honestly.

tools.name: handoff_to_agent
tools.description: Pass the call to the account specialist. Call it only after the caller has heard their details read back and confirmed them, however they were given. Supply the confirmed details. Returns handoff_complete when the specialist has the call.

summary.description: One or two sentences on why the caller rang.

account_reference.description: The caller's account reference, or the last four digits of it.

reason.description: What the caller needs help with, in their words.

tools.name: lookup_account
tools.description: Look up the caller's account by reference: balance, next payment date and any open arrangement.

tools.name: move_payment_date
tools.description: Move the caller's next payment to a new date the caller has agreed to. Returns the confirmed date, or a reason the move is not allowed.

simulator.instructions: You are Priya Nair, calling about your account. Stay in the caller role. Give your details when asked: your name, your account reference ends in 4471, and you want to know when your next payment is due and whether it can move a week later. Do not invent tool results or speak for the assistant. Once you have an answer about the payment date, thank them, say goodbye and end the call.

result.note: The account specialist now has the call and the intake details.

checks.name: the due date reaches the caller

checks.criterion: Before the handoff the assistant took the caller's name, account reference and reason and read them back. After the handoff it did not ask for those details again, looked the account up, answered the payment-date question, and only reported the payment as moved after move_payment_date confirmed it.
